header: Pokémon Snap's extended play plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout
counted, for when a longer play than the regular one (web/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher and Load ROM (RT64
starts only once the game does, so no shader list is built behind this launcher), the boot to the main menu, then
three courses in one load. The beach, started from the main menu by web/survey.cpp, is ridden 25 s by
web/shader_survey.js's ride() (the camera out, photos taken, the items thrown); then next() holds the scene loop's
next scene at the Volcano and quits the beach from its pause menu (Start, Quit) as a player does, so the Volcano
comes in place of the screens after a course, and the same takes the Volcano, ridden 20 s, to the Cave, ridden 20 s.
Where a hold loses, next() goes on through the screens the game chose (the camera check, Oak's lab), so each walk
is given 60 s. Each course's start is a need that fails the run unless the game's scene (Module._snap_web_scene) is
that course. Zero-One rolls on rails, so nothing is timed on the game's clock. A picture of each course is taken
